author: yuutazggnl
quote: I’m never pre-ordering a game again. This is not a proper GTA game. The story line is terrible and full of woke nonsense, the game is unnecessarily realistic which kills the fun, and this whole girlfriend simulator thing is simply annoying. I assume the future updates won’t be able to fix any of this because they’re not bugs, they’re the core part of the game. I tried refunding but couldn’t, because I bought the code in box version. I hate this game so much.
